description: FREE — list your own endpoint + terms in the quote registry. Returns a signed listing receipt (201) with the SELLER-ASSERTED label; a duplicate endpoint+method is refused free (409 DUPLICATE-ENDPOINT). Per-key caps: 100/day, 1s minimum interval (429 when fenced). Phase 1 is free; pricing is an open item.

endpoint_url.description: The endpoint being listed (http/https, no embedded credentials). Validated only — never fetched.

method.description: HTTP method of the listed endpoint.

seller_key.description: Seller identifier (the listing key; per-key caps apply: 100/day, 1s minimum interval).

name: quote_registry_list
